- `nextGeneration` — the function computes the next generation of live cells. All three passing tests exercise exactly that concept (empty grid, lone cell dies, pair dies). Name reveals intent precisely. Keep.
- `liveCells` — parameter holds the live cells of the current generation. Accurate and domain-specific. Keep.
- `Cell = [number, number]` — a coordinate pair. `Cell` is the Game of Life domain term for this; `Coordinate` would be equally defensible but not clearer. Keep.

Verdict: no rename improves intent-revelation.
